continuous_reauthentication_enabled.title: Continuous Re-authentication Enabled
continuous_reauthentication_enabled.description: Indicates whether the ZTNA solution enforces per-session re-authentication at configured intervals or upon context change events, rather than relying solely on initial session establishment.

credential_change_session_revocation.title: Credential Change Session Revocation Policy
credential_change_session_revocation.description: Defines how the system responds to credential change events (password reset, MFA change, token revocation) with respect to existing active sessions.

max_session_duration_minutes.title: Maximum Session Duration (Minutes)
max_session_duration_minutes.description: The maximum lifetime of an authenticated session in minutes before mandatory re-authentication is required, regardless of activity. A value of 0 or null indicates no enforced maximum session duration.

posture_assessment_enabled.title: Device Posture Assessment Enabled
posture_assessment_enabled.description: Whether real-time device posture assessment is actively configured and enforced before granting network access.

posture_checks_enforced.title: Enforced Posture Check Types
posture_checks_enforced.description: List of posture check categories actively enforced — patch_level, certificate_validity, antivirus_presence, edr_presence, disk_encryption.

posture_enforcement_mode.title: Posture Enforcement Mode
posture_enforcement_mode.description: Whether posture assessment results are used to block access (enforce), alert only (monitor), or are disabled.

posture_assessment_max_age_minutes.title: Maximum Posture Assessment Age (Minutes)
posture_assessment_max_age_minutes.description: Maximum allowed age in minutes of a cached posture assessment result before re-evaluation is required. Ensures assessments are real-time rather than stale.

microsegmentation_policy_enforced.title: Micro-Segmentation Policy Enforced
microsegmentation_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether per-workload and per-user micro-segmentation policies are actively enforced, preventing unrestricted lateral movement between segments.

policy_enforcement_mode.title: Policy Enforcement Mode
policy_enforcement_mode.description: The current enforcement mode of the micro-segmentation policies — enforced means traffic is actively blocked, monitor means violations are logged but not blocked, disabled means no policy is applied.

default_deny_policy_applied.title: Default Deny Policy Applied
default_deny_policy_applied.description: Whether a default-deny (allowlist) policy is applied at the workload boundary, ensuring only explicitly permitted traffic flows are allowed between segments.

contextual_signals_enabled.title: Contextual Signals Enabled
contextual_signals_enabled.description: Whether the access control system evaluates contextual signals (location, time, risk score, behavioral baseline) when making authorization decisions, rather than relying solely on static role assignments.

contextual_signal_types.title: Contextual Signal Types in Use
contextual_signal_types.description: List of contextual signal categories actively evaluated during authorization. Expected values include user_location, time_of_access, risk_score, behavioral_baseline, device_posture, network_context.

adaptive_policy_enforcement_mode.title: Adaptive Policy Enforcement Mode
adaptive_policy_enforcement_mode.description: The enforcement mode for adaptive/context-aware authorization policies — enforced means decisions are actively blocking or adjusting access, audit means decisions are logged but not enforced, disabled means no adaptive enforcement.

static_role_only_fallback.title: Static Role-Only Fallback Active
static_role_only_fallback.description: Whether the system falls back to purely static role-based access control when contextual signals are unavailable or fail, effectively bypassing adaptive authorization.

access_log_fields_captured.title: Access Log Fields Captured
access_log_fields_captured.description: List of fields recorded in each access request log entry, such as user identity, device, timestamp, policy rule, decision outcome, and contextual metadata.

log_storage_destination_configured.title: Log Storage Destination Configured
log_storage_destination_configured.description: Indicates whether access logs are forwarded to a persistent, centralized storage system (e.g., SIEM, immutable log store, or audit database).

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days access request logs are retained in the storage system before deletion or archival.

policy_rule_id_logged.title: Policy Rule ID Logged Per Event
policy_rule_id_logged.description: Whether the specific policy rule applied to each access request is recorded in the log entry, enabling forensic reconstruction of authorization decisions.

automated_response_actions_enabled.title: Automated Response Actions Enabled
automated_response_actions_enabled.description: Indicates whether the ZTNA platform is configured to automatically execute policy enforcement responses (session termination, privilege reduction, quarantine) upon anomaly detection or risk threshold breaches without manual intervention.

anomaly_trigger_actions.title: Anomaly Trigger Response Actions
anomaly_trigger_actions.description: List of automated enforcement actions configured to fire when anomaly detection or risk thresholds are breached. Expected values include session_termination, privilege_reduction, and quarantine.

risk_threshold_configured.title: Risk Threshold Breach Trigger Configured
risk_threshold_configured.description: Indicates whether a numeric risk score threshold is defined in the ZTNA system that, when exceeded, automatically triggers policy enforcement responses.

mfa_coverage_scope.title: MFA Coverage Scope
mfa_coverage_scope.description: Indicates which access paths are protected by MFA enforcement — none, partial (only some paths like remote VPN), or all (API, remote, internal, and administrative access).

authentication_bypass_paths_exist.title: Authentication Bypass Paths Exist
authentication_bypass_paths_exist.description: Whether any documented or discovered bypass paths exist that allow access without completing MFA (e.g., legacy protocol endpoints, IP-allowlisted exceptions, break-glass accounts without MFA).

identity_assertion_binding_method.title: Identity Assertion Cryptographic Binding Method
identity_assertion_binding_method.description: The method used to cryptographically bind identity assertions to the authenticated session, preventing token theft and replay attacks.

jit_access_provisioning_enabled.title: Just-In-Time Access Provisioning Enabled
jit_access_provisioning_enabled.description: Indicates whether the system enforces just-in-time provisioning so that privileged access is granted on-demand and automatically revoked after use, eliminating standing elevated permissions.

max_privileged_session_duration_minutes.title: Maximum Privileged Session Duration (Minutes)
max_privileged_session_duration_minutes.description: The maximum time in minutes that a just-in-time privileged session is permitted to remain active before automatic expiration and privilege revocation.

standing_privileged_accounts_count.title: Count of Standing Privileged Accounts
standing_privileged_accounts_count.description: The number of accounts that hold persistent (non-JIT) elevated privileges without time-bound or approval-gated controls. A value of zero indicates full JIT enforcement with no standing privilege exposure.

privileged_access_approval_workflow.title: Privileged Access Approval Workflow
privileged_access_approval_workflow.description: Indicates whether an approval workflow is required before privileged access is granted, ensuring just-enough-access authorization with human or automated oversight.

centralized_policy_management_enabled.title: Centralized Policy Management Enabled
centralized_policy_management_enabled.description: Whether access policies are managed through a single centralized control plane rather than configured individually on each device or node, with version control and conflict detection enabled.

policy_version_control_enabled.title: Policy Version Control Enabled
policy_version_control_enabled.description: Whether policy changes are tracked with version history, allowing rollback and audit of configuration changes over time.

conflict_detection_enabled.title: Policy Conflict Detection Enabled
conflict_detection_enabled.description: Whether the policy management system actively detects and flags conflicting or contradictory access rules before they are committed or deployed.

rbac_policy_administration_enabled.title: Role-Based Policy Administration Enabled
rbac_policy_administration_enabled.description: Whether role-based access control (RBAC) is enforced for administering the policy management system, ensuring only authorized roles can create, modify, or delete access rules.
